name: Capability Recipe Foundry
actions: bind one typed missing-hand specification to its exact verification plan
validate one authored Capability Fabric recipe and builder contribution
bind first-class HAND or SKILL modular capability contracts
assemble a closed object-contract adapter candidate with explicit field loss and structural compatibility boundaries
derive one strict inactive recipe proposal without semantic inference
assemble a digest-bound source-review and external-test packet
materialize or download the exact review packet only after an explicit action
summary: The deterministic recipe-authoring seam between typed capability contracts and Capability Fabric: it builds inactive, reviewable HAND, SKILL, and closed adapter recipe packets without executing or activating them.
notes: EXPERIMENTAL only. Authored builder source and generated code are never executed by the Foundry. Source review, independent tests, catalog integration, Mike's merge gate, installation, promotion, Foundation, and CANON remain outside this module.
